import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Plotting the distribution of Total Spending across different Education levels
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Total_Spending', palette='Set3')
plt.title('Distribution of Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
